outcome.Summary: Fixed three bugs in ledger/ledger.go: (1) Replay now sorts events by timestamp (ties by seq) before applying them, as the spec in doc.go requires; (2) added id-based deduplication so duplicate deliveries (at-least-once) count only once; (3) replaced the truncating int64(float*rate) in toUSD with exact decimal arithmetic (rates parsed back to n/10^4 fractions) and proper banker's rounding (ties to even). Verified with `go test -count=1 ./...` — TestReplayMatchesExpected and TestSimpleDeposit pass, and go vet is clean.
